JSS-BIBTEX-004: Entries with 6+ authors use \shortcites{} or the shortnames class option is enabled
Add the 'shortnames' option to \documentclass{jss}, or list this key in \shortcites{Many}.

JSS-CAP-001: \title{} is in title style (principal words capitalised)

Use sentence style: capitalise only the first word (proper names remain capitalised).
JSS-CAP-004: \Keywords{} is comma-separated and in sentence case
Use sentence case for keywords: do not capitalise words after the first in an entry (proper names and abbreviations excepted).
JSS-CITE-002: First occurrence of a software package has a citation within the same paragraph
Add a citation for \pkg{mgcv} (e.g., \citep{…}) within this paragraph.
JSS-CITE-003: Avoid bracket-in-bracket citation forms like (\cite{...}); use \citep{...} instead
Citation inside parens: replace (\cite{...}) with \citep{...}, or use \citealp{...} when additional text shares the parens.
JSS-CITE-004: Citations use natbib commands (\cite, \citet, \citep, \citealp) rather than hardcoded author-year text
Replace the hardcoded reference '(Knuth, 1984)' with a natbib command (e.g., \citet{Key}).
JSS-CODE-001: Verbatim / CodeInput blocks do not contain comments; comments belong in the surrounding LaTeX text
Move the comment into the surrounding LaTeX text.
JSS-CODE-002: R library() and data() calls quote their first argument
R library() and data() calls quote their first argument
JSS-CODE-003: Code samples use spaces around operators and after commas
Add spaces around operators and after commas in the code sample (e.g., 'y = a + b * x').
JSS-HOUSE-001: "e.g." and "i.e." are followed by a comma so LaTeX does not treat the period as a sentence end
JSS-HOUSE-002: Book editions are indicated as 2nd, 3rd, etc., not as "second" or "2e"
Replace edition 'second' with an ordinal form (e.g., '2nd', '3rd').
JSS-HOUSE-003: Preamble avoids loading LaTeX packages that jss.cls already provides (graphicx, xcolor, ae, fancyvrb, hyperref)

JSS-MARKUP-004: Section titles containing markup supply a plain-text shim via \section[plain]{markup}

JSS-PRE-008: When \Keywords{} contains LaTeX markup, preamble also defines \Plainkeywords{} with the markup-free form
